hook_formula: High-stakes romantic premise with extreme numbers (900 geniuses) to capture instant interest.
story_arc: Setup: Underdog sabotages geniuses competing to marry his crush. Escalation: Personal riddles are posed during the contest. Payoff: The riddles were specifically about him, making sabotage redundant.

character_archetypes.outfit_style: Green spiky hair, striped green-and-black long sleeve shirt, black pants
Dark long hair, black crop jacket, pleated skirt, white high socks

source_transcript: Whoever answers my crush's three riddles gets to marry her. 900 geniuses got them wrong. I failed every test this year, so I made sure they failed too. I hid the chess champion's glasses. I put the professor on the wrong bus. I spilled soda on the robot. It exploded. I never signed up. I watched from the back eating a sandwich. Every time a genius failed, she looked straight at me. First riddle. What's always hungry and never has a pencil? The last genius yelled, a pencil sharpener. Wrong. I whispered, can I borrow a pencil? 900 geniuses turned around. Me? Correct. Second riddle. Who gave me his umbrella in first grade and walked home soaked? A genius screamed, how would anyone know that? Me? Correct. Last riddle. Who am I in love with? 900 geniuses yelled, me? Wrong. The whole town turned to me. Me? She turned bright red. Correct. She walked through the crowd and took my hand. I sabotaged 900 geniuses for nothing.
